cues.en: And a second point is that you shouldn't make very strong statistical assertions based purely on visual appearance, especially in large data sets.

cues.en: Shuffling or permutation testing is a useful statistical inference technique.

cues.en: Now, that said, completely randomly shuffling the way we did here is too liberal for this analysis.

cues.en: A completely randomized shuffle would be appropriate if the embeddings had no autocorrelation over token position.
cues.zh: 只有嵌入跨 token 位置沒有自相關時，完全隨機打亂才合適。
